## NODE char_legba Character "Papa Legba" "Lwa" "Rada"
summary: Gatekeeper lwa who stands at the spiritual crossroads; intermediary between humanity and the spirit world; invoked first in every ceremony; associated with dogs and the crossroads.

## NODE char_damballa Character "Damballah Wedo" "Lwa" "Rada"
summary: Creator lwa of the Rada family; serpent spirit of the sky and waters; associated with wisdom, purity, and creation; offerings include white foods and eggs.

## NODE char_erzulie_freda Character "Erzulie Freda" "Lwa" "Rada"
summary: Rada lwa of love, beauty, and luxury; associated with weeping, jewelry, and the color pink; syncretized with the Mater Dolorosa.

## NODE char_erzulie_dantor Character "Erzulie Dantor" "Lwa" "Petwo"
summary: Petwo lwa of fierce protection and motherhood; warrior spirit; syncretized with Our Lady of Sorrows; protector of women and children.

## NODE char_baron_samedi Character "Baron Samedi" "Lwa" "Gede"
summary: Head of the Gede family; lwa of death and the cemetery; guardian of the crossroads between life and death; depicted in a top hat and dark glasses.

## NODE char_maman_brigitte Character "Maman Brigitte" "Lwa" "Gede"
summary: Consort of Baron Samedi; lwa of cemeteries and death; guards graves and the dead; associated with hot pepper rum.

## NODE char_ogou Character "Ogou" "Lwa" "Rada"
summary: Lwa of war, iron, and fire; defender of Rada values though he carries weaponry; syncretized with Saint James the Greater.

## NODE char_kalfu Character "Kalfou (Kalfu Legba)" "Lwa" "Petwo"
summary: Petwo counterpart of Papa Legba; trickster lwa who controls the crossroads and the forces of mischief; causes accidents that alter destiny.

## NODE char_agwe Character "Agwe" "Lwa" "Rada"
summary: Rada lwa of the sea and marine life; sovereign of the waters; associated with ships, the ocean, and drowned souls.

## NODE place_ginen Place "Ginen" "Lwa" "afterlife"
summary: The spiritual homeland across the sea in Vodou cosmology; origin and destination of the lwa and the ancestors; Africa as the sacred source.

## NODE place_peristil Place "Peristil" "Lwa" "temple"
summary: The Vodou temple where ceremonies are held; contains the poto mitan (center post) through which the lwa descend during possession.

## NODE place_crossroads Place "The Crossroads" "Lwa" "ritual"
summary: The liminal space between worlds where Legba and Kalfu stand; the threshold between the seen and unseen realms.

## NODE obj_poto_mitan Object "Poto Mitan" "Lwa" "temple"
summary: The central pillar of the peristil; the axis mundi through which lwa descend to mount their devotees during ceremonies.

## NODE obj_veve Object "Veve" "Lwa" "ritual"
summary: Ritual drawings made on the ground with cornmeal to invoke a specific lwa; each lwa has a distinctive veve pattern.

## NODE event_possession Event "Spirit Possession" "Divine Horsemen" "ritual"
summary: The central ritual event of Vodou in which a lwa mounts a practitioner (the horse); the possessed person becomes the vessel for the spirit.

## NODE event_transatlantic Event "The Middle Passage" "Divine Horsemen" "history"
summary: The transatlantic voyage that brought enslaved Africans to Saint-Domingue (Haiti); the crucible in which Vodou was forged from West African religions and Catholicism.

## NODE concept_rada Concept "Rada" "Lwa" "nanchon"
summary: The cool, sweet-tempered family of lwa rooted in West African (Dahomey) traditions; includes Legba, Damballah, and Agwe; lwa rasin (root lwa).

## NODE concept_petwo Concept "Petwo" "Lwa" "nanchon"
summary: The hot, volatile family of lwa rooted in the Creole experience of slavery and revolution; includes Erzulie Dantor and Kalfou; associated with fire and power.

## NODE concept_gede Concept "Gede" "Lwa" "family"
summary: The family of lwa associated with death, the cemetery, and sexuality; led by Baron Samedi and Maman Brigitte; known for merriment and irreverence.
